verdict.rationale: Rippling advertises a unified HR/payroll platform with developer APIs, a sandbox, and custom app-building capability (docs-8, docs-43, docs-33), and notes that HR data like new hires flows automatically into payroll (docs-13), which implies some API-driven onboarding is technically possible. However, there is no concrete evidence of specific API endpoints, workflows, or documentation showing an agent can programmatically create an employee record, set compensation, and complete tax setup end-to-end without a human in the UI. missing for 10: explicit API/endpoint documentation for employee creation, compensation setup, and tax onboarding; any example of an agent or automated script performing this flow; independent confirmation of API-driven onboarding success.
